Правила разделяются запятой (или перевод: Rules are separated by commas (or line breaks) — a space cannot be the separator, the rules are made of words themselves. A long list can be pasted as a single line.
A rule is the words of a command in order. “docker system prune” also catches “docker system prune -a --volumes”, and “kubectl get secret” catches “kubectl -n shop get secret db -o yaml”: flags shift the words but do not change their order. A rule with a “|” or “>” sign is searched in the whole line — that is how you write “| bash”. A rule catches the command under sudo too.
